technical.summary: Short-term overbought conditions with bullish micro-structure signals are offset by lack of moving average alignment, weak trend strength (ADX 17.09), and bearish cloud positioning; insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (27/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (361), flat yield curve signals recession risk, strong USD pressures multinational earnings, with earnings event in 28 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme market fear (27/100) creates contrarian opportunity with supertrend bullish signal and RSI overbought conditions suggesting potential reversal from support at 74.19.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely unfavourable (VIX crisis, strong USD headwind, flat yield curve recession signal) combined with technical breakdown (price below EMA-21, SMA-50, and Ichimoku cloud) and high earnings risk in 28 days with zero fundamental catalysts.
